variant_scope: Only observer.ex and subscription_channel.ex switched; all other runtime source, fixture, serializer and measurement settings held fixed. Before uses a separate Observer per private subscription; after embeds private state and releases encoded cache. Shared paths are controls.
boundaries: Synthetic data; real PostgreSQL session checks in one SQL sandbox connection; sequential subject scopes. ChannelTest only, excludes TCP/TLS/Bandit and SDK memory. Forced-GC retained bytes are not RSS savings. No sustained update-rate or connection-capacity claim.
